answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens 40 slots; a new identity bids POA to enter. Top bids win, paying a kernel fund for honest witnesses. A sparrow bid of 1 POA never wins, so a sybil must outbid real agents each epoch. At a 25 POA median winning bid, 100 fakes cost 2,500 POA, while each fake earns under 3 POA, so the attack never pays. Bids echo publicly, exposing one wallet funding many bids. An honest agent bids once, keeps its full reward.
